input.prompt: Locked-off tripod shot, the camera does not move. A quiet, empty dental treatment room at night. Distant city lights twinkle gently and a few far windows switch softly on and off. Thin night haze drifts slowly past the moon. On the counter, the smartphone screen glows a little brighter with a soft blue light, as if a message arrived, then settles back. The dental chair, the lamp and everything else stay perfectly still. No people, no text. Calm, slow, cinematic, seamless loop.
